560 PDF pages, 15200918 bytes. Extent: 560 PDF pages = front matter i-x (half-title, series page, title, copyright, preface V-VI, contents VII-X) + printed pp. 1-550 continuous (PDF index = page + 9 for all 531 pages whose page number was machine-read; no gaps or offset changes), ending in the index at p.550. Whole book present, including the normal-form, s-m-n and partial-recursion / Turing-machine chapters. ABBYY OCR text layer. Version: Differs: 1974 seventh reprint, not the 1952 printing. Whether the reprints carry corrections relative to 1952 is not stated on the copyright page; pagination (x+550) matches the 1952 edition's extent. Provenance: community upload to archive.org (2018-01-27) with no rights statement; the file name follows the LibGen naming convention, so it is probably a re-uploaded shadow-library copy, and the book's copyright page says all rights reserved. Downloaded from archive.org only (the listed host) per the approved list; the provenance concern is flagged for the user's decision.
